entries.system_name: NOVO digital radiography systems for EOD — 15th Engineer Regiment
entries.identity_evidence: The canonical primary-source registry identifies the official 15th Engineer Regiment article of 10 June 2024 as 'Nový rentgenový systém NOVO' and links the ENG-TECH-0031 card to that exact source plus NOVO DR. The card records receipt of 14 NOVO systems while explicitly leaving the precise model unresolved; this review therefore preserves the system-family identity and does not infer a model from appearance alone.
entries.license_evidence: The reviewed official Czech military article and manufacturer material provide exact NOVO system-family image context but do not state a compatible open redistribution licence for repository rehosting. Public availability is not treated as permission to redistribute.
entries.import_blocker: Exact official NOVO system-family source found, but the precise model remains unresolved and compatible open redistribution rights have not been demonstrated; no repository copy, READY_FOR_IMPORT or LOCAL_IMAGE claim is made.
